What we're building

A separate identity and implementation, developed in small testable steps.

Custom interfaceOriginal layout, typography, icon language, and navigation.
Useful performance controlsVisual effects and quality settings that will be connected to the engine later.
Real testingCompatibility and frame-time measurements, not invented FPS numbers.
Prototype controls

Performance lab

These are design placeholders, not connected to the game renderer. We will wire only settings the engine actually supports.

ParticlesFuture control for reducing optional particle effects.
Visual effectsFuture control for optional cosmetic effects.
Performance profilePresets should be based on tested settings, not assumed FPS.
No FPS counter is shown because this prototype has no game loop to measure. That avoids displaying misleading performance data.

Project status

About Radio Client

Radio is being developed as a distinct project with its own interface and implementation.

Current stage: interface scaffoldThe page is a functional static preview, not a playable Minecraft client.
Engine: not connectedNext major milestone is selecting a legally reusable engine/base and establishing a reproducible build.
Redistribution: not clearedWe still need to verify the relevant licenses before publishing a playable build.
Inspired by client-side performance and customization projects. This page does not claim to be a standalone Minecraft implementation.
